description:
ASX: Powering Australia's financial markets

Why join the ASX?

When you join ASX, you’re joining a company with a strong purpose – to power a stronger economic future by enabling a fair and dynamic marketplace for all.

In your new role, you’ll be part of a leading global securities exchange with a strong brand. We are known for being a trusted market operator and an exciting data hub.

www.asx.com.au/about/careers/a-great-place-to-work

We are more than a securities exchange!

The ASX team brings together talented people from a diverse range of disciplines.

We run critical market infrastructure, with 1 in 3 people employed within technology. Yet we have a unique complexity of roles across a range of disciplines such as operations, program delivery, financial products, investor engagement, risk and compliance.

We’re proud to foster a workplace where diversity is celebrated and inclusion is part of our everyday culture. Our employee-led networks champion LGBTIQ+ inclusion, promote gender equality, accessibility and wellbeing, inspire giving and volunteering, and celebrate cultural and religious events, creating a sense of belonging for all. As an AWEI Bronze employer and member of the Champions of Change Coalition for gender equality, we’re committed to a fair and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive.

The Enterprise Customer & Operations team (EC&O) enables ASX to run better. This is through improving customer experiences and interactions, delivering simplified processes and services, integrated delivery planning and capability, and driving consistency of standards.

The Enterprise Enablement team within EC&O is responsible for providing enterprise capabilities and frameworks, that enable and govern data management, change, transformation, delivery, strategy execution, customer products, and process mapping.

The ASX Data Office within the Enterprise Enablement team owns the enterprise data management frameworks, policies, standards and strategy execution required to strengthen how ASX governs, manages, protects and uses data. The team sets enterprise guardrails for data management, provides guidance and oversight to divisions, and supports the uplift of data management capability across ASX.

Your responsibilities:

  • Develop Enterprise Data Management Framework components including policies, standards, procedures and playbooks.

  • Define and deliver process improvement for Data Impacts assessment, data lifecycle processes such as data ownership, classification, data management policies and associated compliance procedures.

  • As a subject matter expert in data management and governance, advise strategic projects on implementing good data

  • management requirements, appropriate data controls and governance processes.

  • Collaborating with Enterprise Risk & Compliance, Legal and Privacy teams, ensure alignment of Data Management framework

  • and associated policies with enterprise risk management framework

  • Collaborating with Enterprise Architecture, tech and business resilience functions, and cyber teams, ensure data management requirements are incorporated in respective frameworks.

  • Support divisions and lines of business teams in planning and implementing Data Management practices, standards, and policies

  • Support data owners in implementing data management practices and processes ensuring critical data and associated risks are withing appetite.

  • Develop and deliver guidance for business areas to implement practical steps to uplift data management

  • Develop/support development of new methodologies, processes, training to deliver data management uplift roadmap

  • Liaise with divisional data owner delegates to coordinate data management uplift activities.

  • Drive and contribute to building a data focused culture and uplifting data literacy at ASX

  • Contribute to a collaborative Enterprise Enablement culture by role modelling ASX values and actively breaking down silos

  • Work across teams and divisions to share knowledge, resolve issues and improve end to end enterprise outcomes

  • Provide leadership and guidance to team members and/or practitioners, supporting capability uplift, performance and effective ways of working

  • Operate effectively in ambiguous and changing environments

  • Demonstrate curiosity and build a deep understanding of the role’s function and the broader ASX context

  • Undertake other activities reasonably required to support the effective operation of the Enterprise Enablement function.

  • Contribute to One ASX culture and adhere to values and cultural expectations as defined across ASX

Must have:

  • Tertiary qualification in business, technology, project management, engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience

  • Demonstrated experience in developing and applying Data

  • Management policies, standards and processes

  • Experience working with a data management framework (industry recognised or organisation specific)

  • Strong knowledge of data management, data risks & controls,

  • and data governance

  • Participating/supporting an organisation wide capability uplift in Data Management and/or Analytics

  • Experience in Data & Analytics role, supporting or delivering a business solution ensuring appropriate risk management

  • Demonstrated communication skills, and the ability to view and explain complex topics in simple terms, telling story with data.

  • Demonstrated analytical capabilities, applied to complex technology & business environments and programs of work.

  • Experience in financial services or similar domain

Nice to have:

  • Working knowledge of a fully integrated Exchange environment would be highly beneficial.

  • Experience working in high impact enterprise-wide, strategic programs, and initiatives.

  • Experience with the full software development lifecycle using traditional and agile methodologies.

  • Experience with agentic data management and governance practices.

  • Naturally inquisitive – asks questions to ensure understanding.

  • Great communicator

We make hiring decisions based on your skills, capabilities and experience, and how you’ll help us to live our values. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all the criteria of this role.

If you need any adjustments during the application or interview process to help you present your best self, please let us know at careers@asx.com.au.

At ASX Group, our diverse workforce is essential to build and maintain a fair and dynamic marketplace. We support flexible working and offer hybrid working options. Even if our roles are advertised as full-time, we encourage you to apply if you are interested in part-time or other flexible working arrangements.

We will arrange for successful candidates to have background checks, including reference and police checks, completed as part of the on-boarding process.

To be considered for this position, candidates must be legally authorised to work in Australia on a permanent basis without any restrictions.

With over 200 million problems submitted to our quantum systems to date, our customers apply our technology to address use cases spanning optimization, artificial intelligence, research and more. At D-Wave, we’re helping customers realize the value of quantum computing today and are shaping the quantum-driven industrial and societal advancements of tomorrow.

About the role

Are you passionate about working with cutting-edge technology, collaborating with world-class minds, and guiding intellectual property through evolving product lifecycles? Do you enjoy intellectually challenging patent drafting and prosecution in a collaborative, supportive environment?

Join our Intellectual Property (IP) team as an In-house Patent Agent / Lead Patent Specialist and contribute your expertise to our growing patent portfolio. This role is suited for a strong independent contributor with clear communication skills, capable of managing complex work and collaborating across teams.

You will work closely with external counsel and internal technical experts, operating with a high degree of independence to proactively identify roadblocks, manage priorities, and exercise sound judgment on when to escalate. You will have the opportunity to contribute to an expanding global patent strategy and other diverse IP initiatives.

What you'll do

title: Patient Safety Attendant
description:
Job Summary

The Patient Safety Attendant is responsible for providing continuous observation and maintaining a safe environment for assigned patients under the direction of a registered nurse (RN). Plays a critical part in ensuring patient safety by adhering to infection control protocols, maintaining patient privacy and dignity, and promptly reporting any changes in patient behavior or condition. Communicates effectively with the RN and other healthcare team members to support high-quality patient care.

Essential Functions

  • Observes and monitors assigned patients to ensure safety, following hospital policies and procedures.
  • Maintains continuous visual observation of the patient and remains with them at all times unless relieved by appropriate personnel.
  • Complies with patient confidentiality standards and adheres to hospital policies regarding privacy and security.
  • Follows infection control precautions, including proper hand hygiene and correct use of personal protective equipment (PPE), in compliance with facility guidelines.
  • Ensures patient environment remains clean and safe, handling bio-hazardous waste and chemicals according to facility policies.
  • Protects patient privacy, dignity, and respect during all interactions and care activities.
  • Assists with non-clinical tasks such as repositioning, reorienting, and engaging patients in appropriate activities to reduce anxiety and restlessness.
  • Reports safety hazards, unusual behaviors, or changes in patient condition to the RN or appropriate personnel immediately.
  • Follows facility safety policies, procedures, and service excellence standards.
  • Completes delegated duties accurately and in a timely manner as directed by the RN.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.
  • Maintains regular and reliable attendance.
  • Complies with all policies and standards.

Qualifications

  • 0-1 years of experience as a patient sitter or similar role in a healthcare setting required

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Ability to maintain continuous patient observation and respond to safety concerns appropriately.
  • Strong verbal communication skills to interact with patients, nurses, and the healthcare team.
  • Knowledge of hospital safety protocols, infection control, and patient confidentiality regulations (HIPAA).
  • Ability to remain calm and composed in high-stress or emergency situations.
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to recognize changes in patient behavior or condition.
  • Professionalism and compassion in all patient interactions.

Licenses and Certifications

  • BCLS - Basic Life Support completed within 14 days of hire required

title: Senior Data Analyst
description:
Are you looking for a career where you can make a real difference in people’s day.

We are seeking a twoSenior Data Analysts to join our team based from our Head Office in London Bridge & Ashford (hybrid working).

In this role, you will act as a trusted business partner, helping operational and commercial teams make better decisions through the effective use of data, insight and performance management. You will identify opportunities for improvement, challenge existing thinking, and translate complex data into actionable recommendations that drive measurable business outcomes.

Working closely with stakeholders across the organisation and the Central Data Team, you will help build a data-driven culture by increasing data literacy, developing Data Champions, and enabling teams to become more self-sufficient in their use of data and insight.

Can you move people? Apply now.

What you’ll do

  • Drive business performance by identifying, monitoring and improving key operational, commercial and customer performance indicators.
  • Deliver high-value analysis and insight that supports strategic objectives and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Build strong partnerships with stakeholders at all levels, understanding business challenges and helping teams use data effectively.
  • Promote self-service reporting and analytics across the organisation, increasing confidence and capability in data usage.
  • Establish and support a network of Data Champions to improve organisational data literacy and analytical thinking.
  • Present analysis and performance information using data visualisation and storytelling techniques that influence decision making.
  • Collaborate with Data Architects, SQL Developers, BI Developers and other members of the Central Data Team to deliver scalable solutions.
  • Identify opportunities to automate reporting, improve processes and increase organisational analytical maturity.
  • Support prioritisation of analytical resources, ensuring effort is focused on activities delivering the greatest business value.

The experience you’ll need

To be considered for this role we recommend you demonstrate the below in your application;

  • You turn data into decisions –You help the business focus on what matters most through evidence-based insight.
  • You are a trusted advisor –You build strong relationships and help stakeholders solve problems using data.
  • You spot opportunities –You identify trends, risks and improvement opportunities before others do.
  • You make insight meaningful –You transform complex analysis into clear, engaging stories that drive action.
  • You build capability –You help colleagues become more confident and effective users of data.
  • You champion self-service –You enable teams to access and use reporting and analytical tools independently.
  • You drive continuous improvement –You look for opportunities to automate, simplify and improve business processes.

As proud members of the Armed Forces Covenant and Disability Confident Scheme, we will offer you an interview if you apply under these schemes and meet the minimum criteria for the role. Find out more here.

Other things to know

  • This vacancy may close early if we receive a large number of applications. So, make sure you get yours in early.
  • All offers of employment are subject to satisfactory references, a right to work verification, a basic criminal record check, and a pre-employment medical assessment. Work visa sponsorship isn’t available for this role.
  • If you applied but weren’t successful in getting a similar role at Southeastern, please wait six months before applying again.

Find out more about our recruitment process and get tips to help you apply.

What you’ll get in return

Along with your salary, the rewards you’ll get include:

  • a final salary pension
  • 25 days annual leave allowance (plus bank holidays)
  • free rail travel across our networks.

Meaning you can feel secure in your career as well as fulfilled by your work. Click here to see our full range of amazing benefits.

A bit about Southeastern

We’re one of Britain's busiest train operators, serving London, Kent and parts of East Sussex. We run over 1,700 trains a day, carrying more than 500,000 passengers and serving 180 stations.

However, working on our railway is more than getting passengers from A to B. It’s about all the little moments that make a difference to their journey.

It’s also about making our railway a great place to work. With a team that represents the communities we serve. This is a journey we’re fully committed to and we’re proud to have been named a ‘Great Place to Work’ at the 2023 National Rail Awards and endorsed as a WORK180 Employer for Women.


Our ways of working are what we expect of everyone at Southeastern. They are powerful. Tiny moments, every day, from every one of us, add up to massive, positive change. Improving how it feels to work here and how it feels to travel with us.

At the heart of everything we do, our Safeguarding Team works to keep our customers, colleagues, and the public safe by improving safeguarding measures and knowledge making sure everyone gets home safe, every day.

Learn more about our railway.

description:
How would you like to work in a place where your contributions and ideas are valued? A place where you can serve with compassion, pursue excellence and honor every voice? At Wellstar, our mission is simple, yet powerful: to enhance the health and well-being of every person we serve. We are proud to have become a shining example of what's possible when the brightest professionals dedicate themselves to making a difference in the healthcare industry, and in people's lives.

Work Shift

Various (United States of America)

Job Summary:

The Sterile Processing Technician provides a key service WellStar to ensure equipment consistently meets the highest quality and safety standards. The individual in this role must be skilled in following protocols with a high level of attention to detail.
This position receives and processes incoming supplies and equipment including performing cleaning and sterilizing duties. He she is responsible for handling, properly processing and storing crucial medical instruments. He/she is responsible for sterilizer equipment monitoring for adherence to performance specifications, including inspection and documentation. He/she prepares packs of supplies, linens, and instruments in Central Sterile Supply or Materials Management as directed.


Core Responsibilities and Essential Functions:

Collects, receives, cleans, disinfects, and decontaminates instruments, supplies and equipment according to hospital policies and procedures, AORN recommendations, AAMI guidelines and JCAHO requirements.
* Collects dirty instruments and equipment from departments throughout the hospital.
* Receives dirty instruments and scans bar code and equipment from the operating room.
* Disassembles and inspects instruments and selects appropriate cleaning tools and detergents to manually decontaminate instruments and equipment.
* Operates washer-decontaminator, cart washer, and ultrasonic cleaner to mechanically decontaminate instruments and equipment.
Inspects surgical instruments and medical equipment and detect need for repair or replacement and inspects for cleanliness, assembles, wraps or containerizes instruments and equipment. a. Unloads Washer and scans bar codes on surgical trays.
* Inspects instruments and equipment to ensure in proper working order and for cleanliness.
* Scans bar code to Select appropriate count sheet for tray and ensures each instrument is accounted for.
* Selects appropriate chemical indicator for inside and outside of package based on mode of sterilization.
* Selects appropriate wrapping method or container.
* Assesses problems with trays and contacts O.R. resource staff and supply coordinator as needed for resolution.
Sterilizes instruments, equipment and supplies as required; handles and stores instruments, equipment and supplies appropriately.
* Appropriately select mode of sterilization for instruments and equipment.
* Loads and unloads sterilizer and documents accordingly.
* Selects biological indicator test pack if necessary for implantables on load.
* Operates steam, gas plasma and peracetic acid sterilizers.
* Appropriately handles, scans bar code and stores sterilized items in predetermined locations for future use.
* Scans bar code and delivers sterile supplies, instruments and instrument trays to units throughout the hospital.
Monitors sterilizers and equipment mechanically, biologically, and chemically in accordance with quality assurance standards and performance improvement standards.
* Inspects sterilizer before use by checking for proper operating order by checking power supply, emptying drains, cleaning, and adding register tape as needed.
* Performs daily biological and diagnostic tests and documents appropriately, factually and legibly.
* Inform leadership in the event of positive biological indicator.
* Selects appropriate chemical indicators internally and externally according to mode of sterilization and documents results.
Maintains established departmental policies and procedures, objectives, quality assurance program, safety, environmental and infection control standards, patient rights and ethics, performance improvement, management of information, management of human resources and leadership.
* Follows established policies and procedures for Blood Born Pathogens and Standard Precautions to identify and reduce the risks of infections among patients, employees, etc.
* Handles all department, patient and hospital information in a confidential manner.
* Makes suggestions for improvement, accepts constructive feedback, assists and accepts assistance from staff members.
* Documents accurately and legibly.
* Maintains a safe, functional and effective environment for patients, staff and other individuals.
* Promotes through action an environment for an interdisciplinary team approach to achieve the mission/goals of the hospital.
* Makes decisions that reflect knowledge of facts and demonstrates good judgment when functioning as a team member of team leader.
Performs other duties as assigned
Complies with all Wellstar Health System policies, standards of work, and code of conduct.

title: Fullstack Engineer (Tesco Mobile)
description:
As a full-stack Engineer, you will be working as part of a high-performance team developing new solutions that put the customer at the heart of the product. We believe in shipping quality, tested, secure and consistent code. You will also work closely with other development teams and the DevSecOps squad to ensure the solution is performant and reliable.

About the team

The Tesco Mobile Development team is a truly cross functional team responsible for the functional software development of bespoke and product / SaaS based IT solutions.

You will be working within a very diverse team of highly motivated and talented individuals on business-critical full-stack development. Our teams are motivated and challenged, working in sprints across a range of technologies which together provide huge benefit to the wider business.

This role sits primarily within the ‘Acquisitions Platform’ squad, which is responsible for developing and maintaining full-stack applications that support Tesco Mobile’s customer acquisition journey as part of the wider ‘I Choose’ tribe. The squad owns several strategic services and is accountable for both their ongoing development and their DevOps responsibilities. Depending on business priorities you may also contribute to other squads.

Ways of working

We’re an Agile organisation. Agile helps us respond quickly to our customers, make the most of our diverse talents, and stay focused on what really matters. It’s more than just a ‘methodology’ to us – it’s our way for everyone to give their best.

We blend office and virtual working. The office is our base, and we work best when we’re together more than we’re apart. But we know that regular office time isn’t right for everyone, and we’re open to talking about complete location flexibility for some roles.

For a small organisation, we use a wide variety of technologies. Plus, our connections with VirginMediaO2 and Tesco means there’s lots of scope for a varied and stimulating opportunities.

Interested? We’d love to hear from you.


  • Be a team player – live the Tesco Mobile values.
  • Work with the squad to deliver in sprints.
  • Developing new solutions, features and driving technical excellence of existing applications
  • Deliver quality, reusable and modular code aligned to the Tesco Mobile standards.
  • Ensure code is documented, tested, secure, performant and can be maintained.
  • Work to refresh existing code as required.
  • Contribute to integration and performance tests for newly developed solutions.
  • Work as part of the team to solve complex cross-business technical problems.
  • Share knowledge with other members of the squad.

We are looking for the following skills & experience:

  • Significant experience implementing full-stack solutions using Django and Python.
  • Extensive experience working with Kubernetes, Docker and Docker Compose
  • Significant experience in using GitHub actions for Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment
  • Solid understanding of AWS and experience performing basic configuration tasks within AWS environments
  • Experience load testing and performance testing.
  • Understanding of databases and SQL query optimisation.
  • Experience delivering applications with a focus on security.
  • Source code systems and branching strategies.
  • Experience building and consuming REST APIs.
  • Willingness to learn new skills.

Nice to have:

  • Basic understanding of Redis, RabbitMQ
  • Proven ability to design, configure, and manage AWS services at a production level
  • Experience in developing software using Golang including design, coding, testing and deploying applications
  • Experience in developing Java applications is desirable but not essential

title: Information Coordinator
description:
We're looking for an Information Coordinator to join our information management team based in Leeds.

Location: Leeds
Hours: 37.5 per week - some flexibility on hours available if desired, just let us know when you speak to us.

We are unable to offer certificates of sponsorship to any candidates in this role.

This is an exciting opportunity to join our information management function, where you'll play a key role in adopting information management processes across projects. You'll ensure compliance with industry and Kier standards, focusing on ISO 19650, whilst helping to deliver against client requirements. With over 30 industry professionals around you, you'll have the support to develop your career and make a real impact.

What will you be responsible for?

As an Information Coordinator, you'll be working within the information management team, supporting them in delivering compliance with ISO 19650 and the Building Safety Act. Your day to day will include:

  • Supporting the management of the CDE throughout the project lifecycle in line with Kier procedures and ISO 19650 standards
  • Managing and hosting training sessions for new users of the project CDE, either in groups or on an individual basis
  • Acting as the main point of contact for ongoing support and coaching, including client teams, designers, and subcontractors
  • Validating, checking, and curating all incoming and outgoing project documentation including receipt, classification, and distribution
  • Configuring and preparing status reports on workflows and other reportable data to inform digital dashboards

What are we looking for?

This role of Information Coordinator is great for you if:

  • You have diverse and clear communication skills with experience of working with multidisciplinary teams and stakeholders
  • You have experience working on projects with large volumes of data and information from various sources
  • You're competent with EDMS such as Asite, Viewpoint, or 4Projects
  • You're proficient with Microsoft 365 suite of tools, specifically Excel, Teams, and SharePoint
  • You're a critical thinker with diligent attention to detail and the ability and willingness to train and support others

We're all about finding potential here at Kier, and transferrable skills are always welcome! So, even if you don't tick every box, please apply and we can have a chat.

Rewards and benefits

We're proud to be able to offer our brilliant people a wide variety of benefits that you can tailor to your needs. You can see more information of benefits here.

Diversity and inclusion

Making Kier a diverse and inclusive place to work is a huge priority for us. We're proud of the steps we've taken so far, but we know we must always do more. Our employees are key in shaping Kier's diversity and inclusion initiatives and our people have made a huge impact on how we work, by using their experiences to shape our policies. You can see our D&I action plan here. As a Disability Confident employer, we will ensure that a fair and proportionate number of disabled applicants that meet the minimum criteria for this role will be offered an interview.

We look forward to seeing your application to #joinkier.

title: Sterile Processing Tech (Certified) - FT Days Weekends
description:
How would you like to work in a place where your contributions and ideas are valued? A place where you can serve with compassion, pursue excellence and honor every voice? At Wellstar, our mission is simple, yet powerful: to enhance the health and well-being of every person we serve. We are proud to have become a shining example of what's possible when the brightest professionals dedicate themselves to making a difference in the healthcare industry, and in people's lives.

Work Shift

Day (United States of America)

Job Summary:

The Sterile Processing Technician provides a key service WellStar to ensure equipment consistently meets the highest quality and safety standards. The individual in this role must be skilled in following protocols with a high level of attention to detail. This position receives and processes incoming supplies and equipment including performing cleaning and sterilizing duties. He she is responsible for handling, properly processing and storing crucial medical instruments. He/she is responsible for sterilizer equipment monitoring for adherence to performance specifications, including inspection and documentation. He/she prepares packs of supplies, linens, and instruments in Central Sterile Supply or Materials Management as directed.

Core Responsibilities and Essential Functions:

Collects, receives, cleans, disinfects, and decontaminates instruments, supplies and equipment according to hospital policies and procedures, AORN recommendations, AAMI guidelines and TJC requirements. * Prioritizes workload according to the needs of the operating room and hospital units. * Collects dirty instruments and equipment from departments throughout the hospital. * Receives dirty instruments and scans bar code and equipment from the operating room. * Disassembles and inspects instruments and selects appropriate cleaning tools and detergents to manually decontaminate instruments and equipment. e. Restocks surgical implantables as appropriate. * Operates washer-decontaminator, cart washer, and ultrasonic cleaner to mechanically decontaminate instruments and equipment. Inspects surgical instruments and medical equipment and detect need for repair or replacement and inspects for cleanliness, assembles, wraps or containerizes instruments and equipment. * Unloads Washer and scans bar codes on surgical trays. * Inspects instruments and equipment to ensure in proper working order and for cleanliness. * Scans bar code to Select appropriate count sheet for tray and ensures each instrument is accounted for. * Selects appropriate chemical indicator for inside and outside of package based on mode of sterilization. * Selects appropriate wrapping method or container. * Assesses problems with trays and contacts O.R. resource staff and supply coordinator as needed for resolution. * Avails him/herself to Operating Room to locate trays and to facilitate turnover of surgical trays. * Communicates with Operating room staff and core techs in prioritizing work load according to the needs of the operating room schedule. Sterilizes instruments, equipment and supplies as required; handles and stores instruments, equipment and supplies appropriately. * Appropriately select mode of sterilization for instruments and equipment. b. Scan barcode on each tray * Loads and unloads sterilizer and documents accordingly. * Selects biological indicator test pack if necessary for implantables on load. * Operates steam, gas plasma and peracetic acid sterilizers. * Appropriately handles, scans bar code and stores sterilized items in predetermined locations for future use. Monitors sterilizers and equipment mechanically, biologically, and chemically in accordance with quality assurance standards and performance improvement standards. * Inspects sterilizer before use by checking for proper operating order by checking power supply, emptying drains, cleaning, and adding register tape as needed. * Notifies Biomedical department in the event of sterilizer or equipment malfunction and notifies CS/SPD and OR manager. * Performs daily biological and diagnostic tests and documents appropriately, factually and legibly. * Activates Recall procedure in the event of positive biological indicator. * Selects appropriate chemical indicators internally and externally according to mode of sterilization and documents results. * Operates, maintains and troubleshoots 3M auto reader equipment to incubate biological indicators. Maintains established departmental policies and procedures, objectives, quality assurance program, safety, environmental and infection control standards, patient rights and ethics, performance improvement, management of information, management of human resources and leadership. * Follows established policies and procedures for Blood Born Pathogens and Standard Precautions to identify and reduce the risks of infections among patients, employees, etc. * Handles all department, patient and hospital information in a confidential manner. * Makes suggestions for improvement, accepts constructive feedback, assists and accepts assistance from staff members. * Documents accurately and legibly. * Maintains a safe, functional and effective environment for patients, staff and other individuals. * Promotes through action an environment for an interdisciplinary team approach to achieve the mission/goals of the hospital. * Makes decisions that reflect knowledge of facts and demonstrates good judgment when functioning as a team member of team leader. Performs department and other related duties as assigned or requested. * Serves as expert resource to the department and participates in orienting and training new staff and perioperative students. * In partnership with Sterile Processing Educators, facilitates department educational programs, inservice meetings and attends meetings as required. * Maintains the cleanliness of work areas as required. * Maintains adequate supplies for inventory control and communicates daily to supply coordinator. * Actively participates in performance improvement activities of the department. * Facilitates intra-operative problem solving related to sterile processing. Distributes supplies and equipment to hospital units in a timely fashion. * Scans bar code and delivers sterile supplies, instruments and instrument trays to units throughout the hospital. * Scans bar codes delivers equipment such as hyperthermia units, difficult urinary cart, isolation carts, portable suction units, central line carts, thoracotomy carts and emergency carts throughout the hospital. * Responds to phone calls from departments for urgent need for instruments, trays, or equipment. Performs other duties as assigned Complies with all Wellstar Health System policies, standards of work, and code of conduct.

Required Minimum Education:

  • High School Diploma / GED General or Accredited Program Other / Related Field-Preferred

Required Minimum License(s) and Certification(s):

All certifications are required upon hire unless otherwise stated.
  • CRCST - Cert Reg Central Service Tech or CRCST-P - Certified Central Service Tech Provisional (1 year) within 1 Year or CSPDT - Cert Sterile Proc & Dist Tech or CSPDT-P - Cert Sterile Proc & Dist Tech - Provisional (1 Year) within 1 Year

Additional License(s) and Certification(s):

Required Minimum Experience:

Minimum 1 year of previous sterile processing experience. Required

Required Minimum Skills:

Must be able to retain knowledge of identification and necessary handling requirements of surgical instruments, medical supplies and equipment. Must be able to understand, speak, and write English fluently to communicate with the nursing, technical and medical staff. Basic computer skills are required.

title: Group Product Manager, Finance Technology
description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit .

About the Role

Reddit is looking for a Group Product Manager to lead the product management of our Finance SaaS portfolio, our systems that run treasury, planning, procure-to-pay, record-to-report, quote-to-cash, payroll, and equity. This is a player-coach role: you'll coach and manage a small team of SaaS product managers who each own a domain of Finance's application stack, while personally owning your own set of applications as a player. This role serves as the orchestration layer for Finance and AI Transformation, requiring you to advise senior executives, influence strategic direction, and navigate complex matrixed environments to translate high-level strategy into measurable business outcomes.

You set the product vision and roadmap across the Finance SaaS landscape, decide what gets built and bought, drive adoption, and own the vendor relationships that underpin the stack. You partner closely with the Enterprise Architecture & Engineering team. They own how systems are built and integrated; you own what we build, why, and when.

You will be at the forefront of our AI-first finance strategy, championing the next generation of intelligent automation to redefine efficiency and scalability across our global operations. If you're energized by translating complex finance processes into clean, well-run systems, thrive at the seam between business and technology, and want to both lead a team and stay close to the product yourself, this role is for you.

What You'll Do

Product Strategy & Portfolio Ownership

  • Own the end-to-end product vision and multi-quarter roadmap for Reddit's Finance SaaS portfolio across P2P, R2R, QTC, payroll & equity, and treasury/investments/EPM.
  • As the lead for Finance & AI Transformation, you are the catalyst for shifting Reddit’s finance teams from manual processes to AI-enabled workflows. This includes championing a “finance engineer” mindset, proactively identifying AI use cases for close automation and anomaly detection, and fostering a culture where data-driven innovation is embedded in our operating model.
  • Translate Finance's priorities (e.g., close acceleration, scalability, public-company rigor, M&A) into a sequenced, defensible roadmap.
  • Lead build-vs-buy and vendor selection decisions; serve as the product voice in Finance technology investments alongside the Enterprise Architect.
  • Define and enforce a consistent product operating model across the team: intake, prioritization, release management, change management, and adoption measurement.
  • Identify opportunities to improve Finance processes through AI-enabled workflows, reconciliations, anomaly detection, approval copilots, and close automation.
  • Drive roadmap prioritization using measurable outcomes such as close cycle reduction, automation rates, SOX compliance effectiveness, and Finance productivity improvements.
  • Establish a single, transparent demand pipeline so Finance stakeholders can see what's planned, in flight, and shipped.
  • Assess the end-to-end finance processes to identify manual workflows, process gaps, control weaknesses, data quality issues, and opportunities to improve and enable AI-powered solutions..
  • Create a cross-functional decision framework for Finance capabilities, including clear ownership, intake, prioritization, readiness criteria, and business sign-off.
  • Identify, design, and launch new features and system capabilities that enhance user efficiency while driving incremental value for the business.
  • Partner with finance leadership to enable AI use across teams, fundamentally shifting the organization toward a "finance engineer" mindset where finance teams are empowered to build, automate, and innovate within our systems.
  • Drive end-to-end finance transformation initiatives across Quote-to-Cash (QTC), Procure-to-Pay (P2P), Record-to-Report (R2R), and Hire-to-Retire (H2R), ensuring alignment between process improvements and long-term scalability.

Strategic Orchestration & Influence

  • Advise senior Finance and Tech leadership on roadmap trade-offs, balancing speed, risk, and long-term impact.
  • Navigate organizational dynamics to secure alignment across Finance, Tech, and Business partners.
  • Promote harmony between internal teams and external integration partners by resolving bottlenecks and managing cross-functional dependencies.
  • Lead a rigorous diligence program to evaluate and optimize system performance, workflows, and adoption metrics to strengthen operational quality.

Team Leadership

  • Directly manage a team of SaaS product managers, each owning a Finance domain (P2P & R2R, QTC, Payroll & Equity).
  • Set clear direction and priorities for each domain, and create space for deep, high-quality product work.
  • Develop your team's craft through roadmap review, stakeholder coaching, and regular 1:1s focused on growth.
  • Serve as an escalation point and thought partner when your PMs hit ambiguity, contention over priorities, or cross-functional friction.
  • Build the bench: define the team's coverage model, identify gaps, and grow the function as Finance scales.

Hands-On Product Ownership:

  • Maintain direct ownership over a specific set of applications, leading their product roadmaps and managing key stakeholder relationships.
  • This isn't a purely managerial role: you'll run intake, prioritize enhancements, manage releases, and partner directly with Finance and the Eng team to deliver in your own portfolio.
  • Stay close enough to the work to credibly coach your team and make sharp product tradeoffs.

Vendor and Demand Management

  • Own Finance SaaS vendor relationships at the portfolio level: renewals, SLAs, roadmap influence, escalations, and spend rationalization.
  • Bring a demand-management mindset to intake; help Finance stakeholders articulate needs, size effort, and sequence work effectively rather than absorbing every request.
  • Partner with Procurement and Finance leadership on tooling spend, contract timing, and consolidation opportunities.
  • Maintain a clear view of total cost of ownership and license utilization across the stack.

Stakeholder Partnership

  • Act as the primary product liaison for Finance leadership, translating business requirements into roadmap decisions and communicating tradeoffs clearly.
  • Partner with FP&A, Technical Accounting, Revenue, Treasury, Payroll, and Finance Operations to understand pain points and proactively surface system improvements.
  • Work hand-in-glove with the Enterprise Architect and Engineering team to land integrations, data quality, and technical delivery against the product roadmap.
  • Support M&A activity (e.g., systems due diligence, gap analysis, integration sequencing, and adoption planning for acquired entities).

What We're Looking For

  • 8+ years in product management, business/finance systems, or finance transformation, including 2+ years directly managing people.
  • Demonstrated ownership of Finance SaaS platforms across multiple domains (ERP, EPM/CPM, procure-to-pay, order-to-cash, treasury, or payroll).
  • Track record of building and running a product/intake operating model: roadmaps, prioritization frameworks, release and change management.
  • Strong vendor management chops: selection, renewals, SLAs, and influencing vendor roadmaps
  • Prior people management experience, with a track record of developing PM or systems-analyst talent.
  • Strong ability to operate across abstraction levels: comfortable in an executive roadmap discussion and in the configuration details of a specific platform.
  • Excellent communication skills: you can frame a portfolio strategy for a CFO and a sprint priority for an engineer in the same afternoon.
  • Strong knowledge of financial controls, audit readiness, SOX requirements, data quality, and compliance impacts.
  • Experience defining close transformation roadmaps, reconciliation strategies, reporting readiness plans, and UAT strategies.
  • Proven success scaling products and owning business outcomes in high-growth, complex environments.

Bonus Points

  • Experience at a high-growth public technology company
  • Familiarity with Reddit's existing Finance tech stack (NetSuite, Workato, Adaptive, Zip, Coupa, Ramp, Workday, Salesforce or comparable) or similar environments
  • Familiarity with advertising platforms and transformation initiatives spanning quote-to-cash or procure-to-pay workflows
  • Experience supporting M&A workstreams (diligence, integration, cutover)
  • Exposure to SOX compliance considerations in finance systems
  • Background partnering with Corporate Engineering or shared-services models

Why This Role, Why Reddit

Reddit's Finance organization is scaling rapidly through organic growth, internal investments, and increasing public-company rigor. This role offers a unique opportunity to shape how Finance technology evolves at a consequential moment: owning the product direction for a portfolio that touches every corner of the company, leading a team, and keeping your own hands on the work.

You'll have the autonomy to set direction, the team support to execute, and the organizational access to make product decisions that stick.

The Staff Platform Engineer leads the effort to locate, make visible, and remediate sources of unreliability in the MANTL platform, including correctness problems that surface under failure conditions. This role works directly in the platform's application codebase (TypeScript) and its container-native deployment environment, combining application-engineering skill with reliability-engineering practice at a level of scope and independence beyond the Sr Platform Engineer. In addition to resolving reactive issues as they surface, this role owns and prioritizes a standing roadmap of known reliability risks, driving that work forward on its own timeline. This role partners with, but is organizationally and functionally distinct from, both Cloud Infrastructure Engineering and product application engineering teams, and is expected to set technical direction and standards for platform reliability work.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Lead investigation, troubleshooting, and resolution of the most complex reliability issues within MANTL platform application code, including microservice communication failures and correctness issues that emerge under failure conditions

  • Set direction for how the platform identifies and addresses failure modes across its third-party and internal system integrations, establishing resilience strategies suited to each integration's specific behavior

  • Own the design and evolution of monitoring, dashboards, and alerting strategy (Datadog preferred) across the platform, ensuring proactive visibility into emerging risks

  • Establish standards and lead implementation of distributed tracing across microservices to accelerate root-cause identification organization-wide

  • Lead diagnosis and remediation of significant application performance issues, including caching strategy, inefficient code paths, and query performance

  • Set direction for platform and application hardening practices, including fault-injection and resilience testing, and drive adoption of defensive design patterns to prevent recurrence

  • Own and improve CI/CD build pipeline architecture (GitHub Actions) supporting deployment of the platform

  • Guide deployment and troubleshooting of container-native (Kubernetes) workloads as part of resolving complex platform reliability issues

  • Define, prioritize, and drive execution of a roadmap of known reliability risks, independent of feature-delivery timelines

  • Establish and maintain documentation and runbook standards covering platform reliability issues, root causes, and remediations

  • Serve as the senior escalation point for complex platform reliability issues, partnering with Cloud Infrastructure Engineering and application engineering leadership on issues that cross domain boundaries

  • Define reliability targets (SLOs/SLIs) for key platform services and advise leadership on reliability risk and tradeoffs

  • Provide technical mentorship and guidance to other Platform Engineers

Recommended Experience & Education

Minimum Years of Experience

7 to 10 years of experience in software engineering, platform engineering, or a hybrid development/reliability engineering role

Education Level

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience

Required

  • Deep proficiency in TypeScript, with significant production experience in a Node.js/TypeScript service environment

  • Strong hands-on experience deploying, operating, and troubleshooting containerized workloads in Kubernetes

  • Proven experience designing, building, and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, GitHub Actions preferred

  • Proven experience designing monitoring, dashboard, and alerting strategy in an APM/observability tool, Datadog preferred

  • Deep experience troubleshooting distributed system and microservice communication failures across a variety of integration points and protocols

  • Strong experience with distributed tracing tools and practices at scale

  • Working familiarity with relational databases, sufficient to diagnose and resolve complex query and schema-level performance issues

  • Proven track record resolving significant application performance issues (caching, inefficient code paths, slow queries)

  • Experience designing and leading failure-mode testing (fault injection, resilience/chaos-style testing) and driving adoption of defensive patterns such as idempotency, retries, and circuit breakers

  • Demonstrated ability to work independently on ambiguous, high-impact reliability problems and to set technical direction for others

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present technical root cause, risk, and remediation plans to engineering and non-technical leadership

  • Experience mentoring other engineers

Preferred

  • Experience with message brokers or event-streaming platforms such as Kafka, particularly at scale

  • Experience with OpenTelemetry or comparable distributed tracing frameworks at scale

  • Experience in a regulated or compliance-driven environment (fintech, banking, or similar)

  • Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code tooling (Terraform or similar)

  • Experience partnering with infrastructure/SRE teams on issues that cross application and infrastructure boundaries

  • Experience influencing engineering roadmap prioritization to secure time for platform stability work

title: Senior Legal Advisor, Corporate and Transactional Law
description:
The Fédération des caisses Desjardins du Québec is seeking a senior legal advisor to join the legal team responsible for providing legal support in corporate and transactional law. As a senior legal advisor, corporate and transactional law, you help protect the organization’s legal interests by ensuring it complies with all laws. You also play a key role in making sure that the organization’s rights are protected and obligations are met. You represent Desjardins in situations involving its legal interests. You lead and influence practitioners on development projects and highly innovative, complex strategic initiatives involving multiple sectors. You help develop and recommend strategic directions and business positions. Your initiatives require extensive, in-depth knowledge of your field of expertise. You make recommendations on the development and execution of projects and initiatives with a very high degree of operational and conceptual complexity. You use your analytical skills and comprehensive, in-depth understanding of your line of business and the organization. Coordination is critical. You interact with a very large number of stakeholders working in a wide range of fields. Interpersonal savvy is therefore essential. You serve as an expert advisor and subject matter expert, as well as a resource person for senior management and decision-making bodies. More specifically, you will be required to:

  • Support the non-organic growth of various business sectors by participating in acquisition initiatives

  • Act at as legal advisor in strategic transactional and corporate files, including strategic investment files

  • Manage the portfolio of Desjardins Group companies, particularly through mergers, corporate reorganizations, intercompany financing, liquidations and dissolutions

  • Provide opinions on the various aspects of transactional and corporate law and companies

  • Draft, review and negotiate documents of a transactional or corporate nature, including articles, bylaws, resolutions, shareholder agreements, share or asset acquisition agreements, partnership agreements, subscription agreements, delegation of authority, mandates and other corporate documents

  • Manage mandates assigned to external legal advisors for major and strategic transactions

  • Analyze applicable regulations and draft the required regulatory applications for a range of transactional files

  • Draft, review and ensure that operations comply with internal governance documents

  • Monitor legislative, regulatory, case law and other changes in corporate and transactional law.

What we offer*

  • Competitive salary and annual bonus

  • 4 weeks of flexible vacation starting in the first year

  • Defined benefit pension plan that provides predictable, stable income throughout retirement

  • Group insurance including telemedicine

  • Reimbursement of health and wellness expenses and telework equipment

* Benefits apply based on eligibility criteria.

#LI-Hybrid

What you bring to the table

  • Bachelor's degree in a related field

  • A minimum of eight years of relevant experience, including six years in business, corporate or transactional law (mergers and acquisitions)

  • Please note that other combinations of qualifications and relevant experience may be considered

  • Member of the Quebec Bar

  • Knowledge of French is required

  • Advanced proficiency of English due to the nature of the duties or work tools or because the position involves interactions with English-speaking partners, members and/or clients

Action oriented, Customer Focus, Differences, Interpersonal Savvy, Nimble learning, Strategic mindset

title: Sr Director - Retail
description:
When you join Verizon

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.

What you’ll be doing...

As a Director of all our store distribution, you’ll be responsible for leading Retail and sales efforts.

  • Staffing/Employee Relations and Development: Developing staff and leading the sales and experience efforts across our Retail channels.

  • Developing and fostering leadership qualities in your direct reports to motivate and coach their teams to achieve high-performance results.

  • Ensuring channel compliance with Business Code of Conduct and Sales Compensation Plan.

  • Rolling out initiatives that will help drive all aspects of the business (e.g., abandon carts, digital partnership, 5G plan).

  • Monitoring financial reporting and manage operating budgets and sales reporting for all stores in your assigned area.

  • Analyzing reports / sales results and develop action plans designed to increase sales productivity.

  • Evaluating customer retention issues to identify opportunities to work cross-functionally with other channels.

  • Serving as a senior management escalation point for customer issues.

  • Fostering a culture where the employee experience consists of purpose-driven behaviors which enable engagement while mitigating risk.

  • Leading and communicating with teams as appropriate to ensure that deliverables are executed and best practices are shared across teams.

  • Leading geographically dispersed teams and facilitating meetings, evaluating issues, providing solutions, and driving results against pressing timelines.

  • Creating a clear strategic vision and the actionable steps necessary to execute that vision.

  • Communicating with senior-level executives regarding complex ideas and processes.

What we’re looking for...

You’ll need to have:

  • Bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience.

  • Six or more years of relevant work experience.

  • Experience leading geographically dispersed and diverse teams with varying levels of employees and positions.

  • Experience facilitating meetings, evaluating issues, providing solutions, and driving against tight timelines.

  • Experience creating a clear strategic vision, including short and long-term brand and business growth strategies, and the actionable steps necessary to execute against that vision.

  • Experience organizing, negotiating, and developing staff while adhering to operational models.

  • Experience meeting deadlines and managing multiple projects simultaneously.

  • Experience communicating with senior-level executives and across different cultures, including communicating complex ideas and processes in a simplified manner to those unfamiliar with the material.

Even better if you have:

  • A Master’s degree.

  • Seven or more years of management experience in a sales environment.

  • A history of strong performance in a results-driven environment.

  • Strong interpersonal and team building skills, including the ability to build trust-based relationships and manage effectively.

  • The ability to take a structured approach to problem solving, keeping process-driven issues front of mind.

  • The ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced, and customer and team-oriented work environment.

  • The ability to foster a work culture composed of purpose-driven behaviors which enable engagement while mitigating risk.

  • The ability to execute a streamlined communication approach to maintain transparency as appropriate.

If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.

Where you’ll be working

In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes working from home and a minimum of three days per week in the office, which will be set by your manager. Employees are responsible for maintaining compliance with hybrid work policies.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Equal Employment Opportunity

Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics.

Benefits and Compensation

Our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of Verizon. From health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD&D insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home & auto insurance. We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award-winning total rewards package. Depending on the role, employees have the opportunity to receive compensation in the form of premium pay such as overtime, shift differential, holiday pay, allowances, etc. Newly hired employees receive up to 15 days of vacation per year, which grows with additional service. For part-timers, your coverage will vary as you may be eligible for some of these benefits depending on your individual circumstances.

The salary will vary depending on your location and confirmed job-related skills and experience. This is a commission based position with the potential to earn more. For part-time roles, your compensation will be adjusted to reflect your hours.

title: Principal Product Manager
description:
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) is seeking an experienced Principal Product Manager to drive go-to-market execution and strengthen cross-product alignment. This role will partner closely with field sales teams to translate customer and market insights into strategic priorities, accelerate key opportunities, and shape a connected, customer-facing roadmap across Oracle's product portfolio.

As a Principal Product Manager, you will ensure product teams clearly understand customer demands and field teams are equipped with clear product direction and compelling value propositions while partnering across Product Management and Marketing functions to deliver a cohesive narrative for OCI’s capabilities, differentiation, and customer value.

The ideal candidate combines strong product and business judgment with past customer-facing experience. This role will need to work across organizational boundaries to deliver measurable business outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

• Drive product and GTM execution in close partnership with field sales and operations teams, translating product strategy into clear priorities, customer engagements, and measurable business outcomes.

• Serve as a strategic connection point between the field and product organizations, synthesizing customer insights, sales feedback, market trends, and competitive dynamics to influence product strategy and investment priorities.

• Partner across Oracle product teams to shape a connected, customer-facing roadmap that brings together capabilities around high-value customer needs, use cases, and market opportunities.

• Shape commercial strategy for new products and offerings, applying sound business judgment to customer expectations and financial constructs that balance market demands, competitive positioning, and sustainable business models.

• Partner with Product Marketing and Corporate Marketing to develop a cohesive OCI narrative, ensuring consistent positioning, differentiation, and value propositions across products, campaigns, and field engagement.

• Identify cross-product gaps, dependencies, and barriers to customer adoption, driving alignment and action across organizations to improve the end-to-end customer experience.

• Influence senior leaders and stakeholders across globally distributed organizations, creating alignment and driving execution across complex initiatives without direct authority.

title: IT Project Manager
description:
Primary Location :

BIGGLESWADE, United Kingdom

At Solina, our community of close to 5,000 people share a passion for food and live our entrepreneurial culture.

We design customised savoury solutions for our clients operating in the food industry, food service, butchery and nutrition markets. With sustainability at the heart of our business model, we aim to produce food that is good in every sense of the word: delicious, nourishing, affordable, sustainable and convenient.

Solina is a fast-growing business, with around 50 production sites and R&D laboratories present in more than 19 countries mainly in Europe and North America.

By constantly rethinking culinary solutions, we make food matter for people and the planet.

If you're ready for a new adventure in a dynamic, expanding, passionate, international company, join us !

Solina is looking for an IT Project Manager with an industrial/manufacturing background to lead the delivery of enterprise application projects across our manufacturing sites and business functions.

You will manage end-to-end projects within our global IT Build organization, covering ERP, PLM, CRM, supply chain systems, and integrations. This role owns scope, planning, governance, budget, vendor coordination, deployment, and adoption. Run/Operations teams retain ownership of support; however, you will provide Level 3 expertise for complex incidents.

The ideal candidate will have proven experience delivering IT projects in an industrial, manufacturing, or production-driven environment, with a strong understanding of site operations, business processes, and cross-functional stakeholder management.

This position will be based in Biggleswade, UK.

Key responsibilities

Demand intake & scoping

  • Gather business needs and translate them into clear IT requirements and functional specifications.

  • Challenge demand against the Group digital roadmap and standard solutions where relevant.

  • Define scope, assumptions, constraints, success criteria and delivery approach (waterfall/agile/hybrid).

  • Provide high-level estimations (effort/costs), resource needs and delivery options.

Planning, governance & reporting

  • Build and maintain delivery plans (milestones, dependencies, resources, budget) and ensure execution.

  • Define and run project governance (steering committees, project controls, regular status reporting).

  • Maintain RAID management (Risk/Action/Issue/Decision logs) and drive timely decisions.

  • Coordinate cross-program dependencies and ensure consistent reporting to leadership.

  • Be the contact person for the business and IT project members

Budget & vendor management

  • Estimate workload and costs (internal effort, licenses, external partners) and manage budget tracking.

  • Participate in RFPs, vendor selection and contracting support; review statements of work.

  • Control subcontractor effectiveness and delivery quality throughout the engagement; manage change requests.

Solution delivery & quality

  • Coordinate design/build/configuration, integrations, data migration and deployment across IT teams and partners.

  • Define and manage testing strategy (SIT/UAT), acceptance criteria, defect management and release readiness.

  • Ensure testing is evidence-based (test results reviewed, logs checked where relevant) and includes end-to-end validation reflecting production constraints (e.g., printing/scanning or other peripherals when applicable).

  • Ensure documentation is produced and kept up to date (solution, procedures, handover pack).

Change, deployment & adoption

  • Prepare and execute cutover/go-live plans, communications, training and hypercare.

  • Support change management and business readiness activities; ensure stakeholder alignment.

  • Ensure operational risk is controlled through readiness checks, testing evidence and structured transition to Run.

Transition to Run & Level 3 expertise

  • Plan and execute structured transition to Run (knowledge transfer, service acceptance, support model, KPIs).

  • Provide Level 3 functional/technical expertise for complex incidents/major problems (Run remains the ticket owner).

  • Support root cause analysis and corrective action plans with Run teams and vendors to prevent recurrence.

Business analysis support for small/medium initiatives

  • For smaller initiatives (e.g., local apps, workflow automation), facilitate workshops, document requirements and translate them into actionable work items and acceptance criteria.

  • For large programmes (e.g., ERP rollouts), coordinate with product owners, business analysts and solution leads to ensure a complete and validated requirements baseline.

Success measures (examples)

  • Milestones delivered on time with controlled scope and documented decisions.

  • Budget and vendor performance effectively managed with clear accountability.

  • Go-lives executed with stable hypercare, clean operational handover and limited disruption to plants.

  • High stakeholder satisfaction and measurable adoption of delivered solutions.

  • Reduced recurrence of major issues through effective root cause analysis and corrective actions.

Your Profile

  • 6/8 years of IT project management experience (with an industrial background)

  • Proven ERP or enterprise application implementation experience regarding production and/or supply chain

  • Solid understanding of integrations, APIs, and data migration

  • Experience in manufacturing and multi-site environments preferred

  • Strong stakeholder management across functions and geographies

  • PMP certification preferred; Agile certification is a plus

  • Fluent English required

  • Professional ethics

  • Willingness to travel

If you are comfortable operating in an international environment and driving structured, high-quality delivery across complex landscapes, we invite you to apply.

We are open to talents of all backgrounds. Our recruitment process is based on competences, and we openly welcome all candidates of all types according to our DEI Commitment

description:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. We are seeking a highly technical and innovative Lead Engineer, Authentication Engineering to lead the design, implementation, and advancement of enterprise authentication platforms. Multiple Managing Engineers for authentication teams will report to this role. This role will provide technical leadership for authentication solutions, including directory infrastructure, multi-factor authentication (MFA), PKI, privileged access management and vaulting solutions and an in-house developed application for password and MFA management.


The successful candidate will partner closely with Product Management, Cybersecurity, Infrastructure Engineering, Application Teams, and Operations to deliver secure, scalable, and resilient authentication capabilities that align with strategic directions including AI enablement, Zero Trust, Infrastructure as Code, and automation.

  • Partner with Authentication Lead Product Manager for creation of strategy, roadmaps, prioritization, and implementation of solutions.

  • Own the reliability, resiliency, and operational excellence of authentication services by defining and achieving SLOs, improving service availability and performance, instrumenting and enhancing observability, and leading incident response efforts to reduce MTTR.

  • Evaluate emerging technologies and industry trends, establish engineering standards and best practices, and provide technical leadership across authentication domains.

title: Continuous Improvement Engineer
description:
Futures are looking for an experienced and proactive Continuous Improvement Engineer to join our team and drive measurable improvements across our operations.

The successful candidate will have a strong working knowledge of Lean strategies and methodologies, process improvement techniques, and ISO accreditation and compliance requirements. You will work closely with engineering, operations, quality, and leadership teams to identify improvement opportunities, eliminate waste, improve efficiency, standardise processes, and embed a culture of continuous improvement.

This role would suit an engineer who enjoys analysing how processes work, challenging existing ways of working, and turning improvement opportunities into sustainable, measurable results.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and support continuous improvement initiatives across engineering, manufacturing, operational, and business processes.
  • Apply Lean principles and strategies to identify and eliminate waste, improve process flow, reduce variation, and increase productivity.
  • Facilitate improvement activities using methodologies and tools such as Kaizen, 5S, Value Stream Mapping (VSM), Standard Work, Visual Management, Root Cause Analysis, PDCA, DMAIC, and problem-solving techniques.
  • Analyse operational and process data to identify trends, bottlenecks, inefficiencies, quality issues, and improvement opportunities.
  • Develop clear business cases for improvement projects, including expected cost savings, productivity improvements, quality benefits, and return on investment.
  • Lead improvement projects from initial problem identification through implementation, measurement, standardisation, and sustained control.
  • Establish and monitor appropriate KPIs and performance measures to demonstrate the impact of improvement activities.
  • Work collaboratively with operational teams to develop practical solutions that can be successfully embedded into day-to-day working practices.
  • Support the development and maintenance of ISO-accredited management systems, ensuring processes, procedures, records, and improvement activities meet applicable standards.
  • Support internal and external ISO audits, including preparation, evidence gathering, corrective actions, and the closure of non-conformances.
  • Conduct or support root cause investigations and ensure corrective and preventive actions are effective and sustainable.
  • Develop and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), process documentation, work instructions, and process maps.
  • Coach and engage colleagues in Lean thinking and continuous improvement methodologies.
  • Promote a culture in which employees are encouraged to identify problems, suggest improvements, and take ownership of operational excellence.
  • Ensure improvements are implemented with appropriate consideration for quality, health and safety, regulatory requirements, and customer expectations.

Essential Skills & Experience

  • Proven experience in a Continuous Improvement, Process Improvement, Manufacturing, Quality, Industrial, or Engineering role.
  • Strong practical knowledge of Lean strategies and methodologies.
  • Demonstrable experience delivering measurable process improvements within an operational or engineering environment.
  • Good working knowledge of ISO accreditation, management systems, auditing, compliance, and continuous improvement requirements.
  • Experience supporting an organisation through ISO audits, accreditation, surveillance audits, or recertification.
  • Strong understanding of structured problem-solving and root cause analysis.
  • Ability to interpret operational data and translate findings into practical improvement actions.
  • Experience developing and monitoring KPIs and improvement metrics.
  • Strong project management and organisational skills.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the confidence to work across different levels of an organisation.
  • Ability to challenge existing processes constructively and influence teams to adopt improved ways of working.
  • A structured, analytical, and results-focused approach to problem-solving.

Desirable Skills & Qualifications

  • Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Operations, or related degree/HNC/HND qualification.
  • Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification.
  • Formal Lean Manufacturing or Continuous Improvement qualification.
  • ISO Internal Auditor or Lead Auditor qualification.
  • Experience working with standards such as ISO 9001 and other relevant ISO standards applicable to the organisation.
  • Experience within a regulated, manufacturing, engineering, technical, or quality-controlled environment.
  • Knowledge of statistical process control (SPC), FMEA, process capability, and other quality improvement tools.

  • Administrative Operations: Support purchase order generation, vendor invoice processing, asset tracking, and metadata updates in coordination with library and production teams.
